terra.problem: Calling Eliab's name a mouthful jokes about how a name is said. The explanation also guesses why the baker chose it.
Saying nobody hands Bezalel a sword and that he is handed a workbench invents details the passage does not give.
“Some of you” addresses a group and assumes the baker is behind on a to-do list.
The joke treats a five-day workweek as unusually short, although it is a common workweek. The comparison does not click.
Calling the third day a workday and saying to keep stamping suggests work is required. The passage says work may be done on the six days.
